<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/projects/{projectId}/agent-costs"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



A SLIDING 30-day window, not the current calendar month: that is the label the screen shows, and with a calendar month the estimate would plunge on the 1st from the page turning over, not from a change in usage. Only `actor_kind = agent` counts (RN-038). An agent that never ran does not appear in the list — the screen shows a dash for it, which is different from zero.
